title: Notes on the Development of Telephone Service. III
version: Popular Science Monthly, vol. 70, January 1907, section VI; Wikisource transcription
lineage: 1907 historical account in a transcription of the published article; Coy is named as a living contemporary. The original manuscript and contemporaneous company accounts were not inspected. Estimates and priority claims are not adopted as proven facts.

passages.note: Section VI: 21 January initial service with about thirty subscribers, 28 January formal opening; rates and February subscriber list
